saklakov.kind: replication (exact parameter limit of our solver)
saklakov.source: Saklakov 2026, arXiv:2601.04234: comply-versus-confront MDP, Lemmas 1-2 and Table 1
omissions: Stationarity: his 'confront now or never' (footnote 3) has no counterpart test; our model is not stationary.
Theorem 2 (humans pre-empt when Delta >= 0): our humans cannot strike first, so only the AI's opening move is compared.
Success-probability extension s* (docking/saklakov.py section 4) is ours, not his; not gated here.
Table 1 values were transcribed into docking/saklakov.py on 2026-10-21; this PR did not re-read the source.

clark.kind: replication of a closed-form ledger (term-for-term identity) plus solver sign agreement
clark.source: Clark 2026, arXiv:2609.00109, section 4.4 removal row R4 and its corollary 'S > d => never remove'
omissions: Clark prints no numbers; the gate checks the ledger's form and corollary, not published values.
Compliance-capture and welfare-goal responses (his 2 and 3) have no counterpart in our model.
Bypass row Rb is not docked (our off-Earth growth recovers none of the rival discount d).
The solver's strike-minus-comply gap differs from R4 by up to 0.009 per year in the comply region (docking.md section 4); the cause is not established, so it is reported, not gated.

powell.note: Evaluates Powell's inefficiency condition (1) on our own quantities. No second implementation and no published numbers are reproduced.

potapov.kind: qualitative direction check, not a replication
potapov.note: Potapov has no formal model. Tests a formalisation we wrote of his suggested dependence variable, and the sign of a patience sweep of our full model.

metzger.kind: data comparison against a digitised figure, not a replication
metzger.note: Growth rates compared with values read by eye (+/-15%) from his figure; his spreadsheet model is unreleased, so no model output is reproduced.
